confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of London price levels; no live menus, hotel rates or listings were checked. Accommodation is least certain because July peak-season rates vary widely by zone and booking date. USD values assume a working rate of about 1.33 USD per GBP, not a live quote. Beer is a 568 ml pint; meal figures exclude drinks and tips; cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer price relationship. The RBA rate came from search-result summaries rather than a direct read of the RBA table, so verify it before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No web search was used for city prices. Benchmarked against London's own price level and against other high-cost Western European capitals such as Paris and Amsterdam, with London accommodation placed at the upper end of that group.

anchor_basis.beer: pint (568 ml) of draught British lager or ale in a central London pub or restaurant, about £6.80
anchor_basis.coffee: cappuccino at an independent London cafe, about £3.80

anchor_basis.cocktail: standard cocktail such as a gin and tonic or negroni at a central London bar, about £13
anchor_basis.wine_glass: 175 ml glass of house wine at a mid-range London restaurant, about £10

anchor_basis.hostel_private_2p: private twin or double room at a central London hostel in July, about £130 per night
